activeCadence.startLabel: The river separates the starting bank on the left from Grandma’s hill on the right. The old footbridge is broken. Pip is on the left bank, wearing the backpack you made. Grandma waits on the hill across the river. The loose seed is on the left bank. It is dark. The little boats are separate.
activeCadence.endLabel: The river separates the starting bank on the left from Grandma’s hill on the right. The old footbridge is broken. Pip is on Grandma’s hill, wearing the backpack you made. Pip and Grandma are together on the hill. The seed is on the hill with Grandma. It is still loose and dark. The joined boats stretch across the river.

scope: Automated Windows/loopback/DPR emulation, not physical hardware or internet measurement. RAF cadence is sampled during an actual running rehearsal with two Canvases, changed story pixels and changed committed description; it is a scheduling proxy, not measured physical display FPS. Image dimensions, pool reservations, all native consumers and explicit buffer/reserve arithmetic are conservative estimates, not measured total browser/GPU memory. PNG interception disables normal browser caching. Existing all-variant allocation failures remain in production-art-verification.json.
